page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 2 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but weaker multi-core and memory scaling. The single-core Geekbench score of 1558.0 and stress-ng single-core CPU performance of 1875.88 place it in the average tier. However, multi-core benchmarks, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 3318.0 and Passmark CPU score of 5908.52, fall into the weaker category. Memory bandwidth tests show 210.77 GB/sec for cached small blocks and drop to 28.05 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Cryptographic operations perform moderately well, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 3651.65 and support for hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions.

Given its balanced resource allocation, the instance is positioned for general-purpose workloads that do not demand high multi-threaded throughput or intensive memory bandwidth. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight text processing, and small-scale application hosting. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs, combined with its moderate performance profile, makes it a cost-efficient option for development environments, utility servers, and workloads with predictable, low-to-moderate resource utilization.
